datasets.name: filter_values
queryLines:
with sales as (
select f.fk_salesorderid as order_id, f.orderdate, date_trunc('month', f.orderdate) as order_month,
    cast(year(f.orderdate) as string) as order_year, date_format(f.orderdate, 'MM - MMM') as month_label,
    case when f.onlineorderflag then 'Online' else 'Reseller' end as channel,
    cast(f.status as string) as order_status,
    f.orderqty as units, f.salesorderdetailsubtotal as gross_sales, f.salesorderdetaildiscount as discount,
    f.salesorderdetailnetsubtotal as net_sales,
    p.product_name, coalesce(p.productcategory_name, 'Unknown') as category,
    f.fk_customerid as customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type,
    a.city, a.stateprovince_name as state, a.countryregion_name as country,
    coalesce(cc.cardtype, 'No card') as card_type
from dev.dbt_lmilaremietto.fact_sales as f
left join dev.dbt_lmilaremietto.dim_products as p on f.fk_productid = p.pk_productid
left join dev.dbt_lmilaremietto.dim_customers as c on f.fk_customerid = c.pk_customerid
left join dev.dbt_lmilaremietto.dim_addresses as a on f.fk_shiptoaddressid = a.pk_addressid
left join dev.dbt_lmilaremietto.dim_credit_cards as cc on f.fk_creditcardid = cc.pk_creditcardid
)
select distinct order_year, month_label, channel, country, state, city, category, card_type, order_status
from sales
